# Ryan Yarali

> Ryan Yarali is a full-stack developer and a Computer Systems Technology (CST) diploma student at BCIT, the British Columbia Institute of Technology, on the Data Communications & Cyber Security option. He is based in Coquitlam, in Greater Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, and is open to internship, co-op and junior developer roles. ryanyarali.com is his portfolio.

Key facts:

- Name: Ryan Yarali
- Role: Full-stack developer
- Education: Computer Systems Technology Diploma, British Columbia Institute of Technology (BCIT), Data Communications & Cyber Security option. Sept 2025 to Apr 2027 (expected); currently in Term 3.
- Location: Coquitlam, Greater Vancouver, BC, Canada
- Looking for: internship, co-op and junior developer roles
- Freelance web work (prices in CAD, starting points; fixed quote after a free 20-minute call; two rounds of changes included): portfolio site from $350; one-page site from $450; business website (up to 5 pages) from $900; bookings or online store from $1,500; care plan $39/month. Add-ons: extra page $90, second language (incl. Farsi/right-to-left) from $250, copywriting from $150, domain and email setup $60, LinkedIn refresh $80, rush delivery +25%. Also: website refresh from $400, Google Business Profile setup $150, custom web apps by quote. Referrals: the new client gets 10% off their first project and the referrer gets $50 off their next invoice. Details: https://ryanyarali.com/#pricing
- Work: 15+ projects shipped; four are shown publicly with the clients' permission (listed below), plus this site
- Contact: the form at https://ryanyarali.com/#contact
- GitHub: https://github.com/RyanYarali
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ryan-yarali/

Skills listed on the site:

- Languages: JavaScript, C, C++, Python, Java, PHP, SQL, HTML5, CSS3
- Frontend: React, responsive design, accessibility fundamentals
- Backend: Node.js, Express, REST API design, WordPress, Pods
- SEO and performance: on-page and local SEO, structured data (JSON-LD), Core Web Vitals tuning, image optimization
- Networking: TCP/IP, socket programming, network protocols, packet analysis
- Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
- Systems: Linux/Unix, systems programming, systems analysis
- Workflow: Git/GitHub, Agile/Scrum, testing and debugging, OOP, data structures

## Projects

- [Nook Look Studio](https://ryanyarali.com/projects/nooklook.html): Client site, 2026, live at https://nooklook.ca. The full web presence for a Coquitlam portrait photography studio: four priced service lines, a booking pipeline, a filterable gallery, and local SEO, built and launched solo. WordPress, Pods, PHP, custom CSS/JS, hand-written LocalBusiness structured data.
- [Vancobab](https://ryanyarali.com/projects/vancobab.html): Client site, 2026, live at https://vancobab.ca. A five-page site for a Persian kebab food truck in Vancouver with its own Persian visual identity (toranj medallion, ogee trellis). While the truck gets ready it runs as a pre-launch site collecting a launch list; a vanilla JavaScript order builder (combos and a five-step build-your-own wizard, no backend or payment) is ready for opening day. HTML5, CSS3, vanilla JavaScript, Web Animations API, Web3Forms.
- [Termeh Cafe & Restaurant](https://ryanyarali.com/projects.html): Client site, 2026, coming soon. A bilingual English and Farsi restaurant site with a password-protected admin panel for the menu, prices, hours and reservations. React 19 and Vite on the front end; Node.js, Express and SQLite on the back end.
- [TaskMate](https://ryanyarali.com/projects/taskmate.html): BCIT coursework, 2025. A mobile-friendly task manager for students, built end to end with Firebase Authentication and Firestore as a team project in COMM 1800 (Team DTC 09) and tested by a nine-person class team. Source: https://github.com/RyanYarali/1800_202530_DTC09
- [FoodRoutes](https://ryanyarali.com/projects/foodroutes.html): BCIT COMP 2800 team project (team of four), 2026. A mobile web app that finds affordable groceries nearby and gives directions there by transit, walking, cycling or driving. Ryan built the navigation map (directions in four travel modes, saved routes in Supabase capped at the 10 most recent, "Use my location") and the accounts flow (Supabase login and sign-up with validation, a guided intro.js tour, protected routes). React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Supabase, Google Maps JavaScript API. Code: https://github.com/RyanYarali/2800-202610-DTC09
- [Hacker Tycoon](https://ryanyarali.com/projects/hackertycoon.html): BCIT COMP 2522 term project (team of two), 2026. A JavaFX idle tycoon game: hacking jobs earn crypto while a suspicion meter rises toward an FBI raid that takes half of it; random events, two upgrade shops, eight badges, save and load, 1x/2x/5x speed. Ryan wrote about 80% of the game code: the game screen and loop, save and load, the sound system, random events, colour-coded logs and badges. Java 25, JavaFX, Gradle, CheckStyle. Code is private under course rules.
- [This site](https://ryanyarali.com/projects/this-site.html): ryanyarali.com itself. Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript on Cloudflare with no framework and no build step; a three.js network globe, scroll-driven motion, six colour palettes that meet WCAG AA, and every word in the HTML. Source: https://github.com/RyanYarali/RyanYarali.github.io
